hooks.name: sync-spec-map-and-usage-writeup
hooks.description: When a spec changes, Kiro updates the spec map in README and the Kiro usage write-up so judges never read stale claims.

action.prompt: A Kiro spec file just changed. Update the spec table in README.md and the relevant section of docs/KIRO_USAGE.md so requirements, task IDs and correctness-property IDs stay consistent. Do not invent Kiro sessions that did not happen.

hooks.name: evidence-reminder-on-stop
hooks.description: Before the agent finishes, remind the developer to log real session evidence for the hackathon write-up.

action.prompt: If this session produced code changes, remind Jayant to append one row to docs/KIRO_EVIDENCE.md with date, Kiro surface used, command/PR and test output. Only real evidence belongs there.
